card.name: Inside split-up drug brand names
card.fires_on: Fragments in the middle of a drug or product name that the tokenizer split into pieces, such as the 'acho' in TachoSil, 'ised' in risedronate, 'pez' in donepezil and 'mod' in armodafinil. It fires after the first piece, when the rest of the name is still to come.
